concerns.text: T000-run depends on T006c, but T006c depends on T000-script. T000-run (execution) must depend on T000-script (creation) directly. The current chain T000-run -> T006c -> T000-script is logically valid but T000-run is marked [S] while T000-script is [P], creating a potential race if T000-script hasn't finished when T000-run starts. More critically, T000-run depends on T006c which is config init, but the script execution logic requires the script file to exist first. The dependency T000-run -> T000-script is missing.

T014 (Meta-Analysis) depends on T017 (Egger's) and T018 (I²), but T014 is described as writing the final results.json which T017/T018 also write to. This creates a race condition where T014 might write results before T017/T018 complete, or T017/T018 might overwrite T014's results. The task list does not specify the order of writing, leading to inconsistent data.

T015 (Visualization Orchestrator) depends on T014 (Meta-Analysis), but T014 is described as writing results.json which T015 needs. However, T017 and T018 (Egger's/I²) are also dependencies of T014 and they also write to results.json. If T014 runs first and writes the file, T017/T018 will overwrite it, but T015 might read the intermediate version, leading to inconsistent data being visualized.

T016 (Main Orchestrator) depends on T015a and T015b, but T016's description states it invokes pivot_narrative.py (T015d) which then invokes T015b. This creates a circular dependency where T016 waits for T015b to complete, but T015b is only supposed to run after T016 triggers the narrative path, making the pipeline deadlocked for the narrative fallback scenario.

T024, T025, T026 (Visualization scripts) depend on T042 (Memory-Safe Plot Generation) and T015 (Orchestrator), but T042 is described as 'refactoring' existing scripts, while T024-T026 are the scripts being refactored. This implies T042 must run before T024-T026 are created or at least before they are executed, yet T024-T026 are listed as dependencies of T015 which is needed to trigger the visualization, creating a 'refactor before use' paradox.

T053 (Resolve Unspecified Visualization Dependency) is a new task to implement memory_safe_plots.py which is referenced by T024-T026, but T024-T026 are already listed as dependencies of T015 and T042. If T053 is not completed before T024-T026 run, the visualization tasks will fail, yet the task list does not enforce T053 as a prerequisite for T024-T026, only T042 (which is 'refactoring' not 'creating').

T009b (Real Data Validator) is described as not raising an error if studies.csv is missing (it copies mock data), but T012 (Qualitative Extraction) and T013 (Parser) require data/raw/studies.csv to exist. If T009b is skipped or fails to run before T012/T013 (due to dependency ordering), the extraction tasks will fail immediately, yet the task list does not enforce T009b as a hard prerequisite for T012/T013, only for T009 (which is a different task).

T014b (Valid Pair Counter) is listed as a dependency of T014 (Meta-Analysis), but T014's description says it reads study_count.json (from T014a) and real_data_status.json (from T009b); T014b produces valid_pair_count.json which is not mentioned in T014's logic, suggesting T014b is an orphan task or T014's description is incomplete regarding the use of valid pair counts for the random-effects model.

T052 (Resolve Data Flow Dependency) is a new task added to fix the issue of T014 not depending on T017/T018, but T014 is already listed as depending on T017/T018 in the task list; this suggests the task list is internally inconsistent (T014 depends on T017/T018, but T052 says it doesn't), or T052 is a redundant fix that doesn't address the root cause of the file writing order.

T055 (Resolve Mock Data Consistency) is a new task to ensure mock_studies.csv includes tract_name from the lexicon, but T000-run (Generate Default Mock Dataset) is already supposed to generate this file with 5 distinct tracts; if T055 is needed, it implies T000-run is defective, yet T000-run is marked [X] (Completed) and not flagged as failing verification, suggesting the task list is out of sync with the actual state of the code.
